description: This Java source file defines the SelectContactActivity class, which is an Android activity for selecting a contact to share text with. It displays a list of contacts and handles user selection to return the chosen contact.

classes.name: SelectContactActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a list of contacts for sharing purposes and handles user selection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures the contact list and click listener.

methods.name: mAdapter.getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of contacts available.

methods.name: mAdapter.getItem
methods.description: Retrieves a contact object by its index.

methods.name: mAdapter.getItemId
methods.description: Returns the item ID, which is the index itself.

methods.name: mAdapter.getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a view for a contact item and binds contact data to it.

methods.name: mOnItemClickListener.onItemClick
methods.description: Handles contact selection, packages the contact ID into an intent, sets the result, and finishes the activity.
